title: Pair cost
description: What buying both Up and Down together costs on this venue. The pair always pays out one dollar, so above a dollar after fees the venue is charging a premium.

state.label: Pair cost state
state.description: Premium when the pair costs more than it pays, discount when less, fair in between. A discount is free money until it closes.

pair_cost.label: Pair cost
pair_cost.description: The Up ask plus the Down ask, in dollars per pair, before fees. One dollar is fair.

fee_adjusted_pair_cost.label: Pair cost after fees
fee_adjusted_pair_cost.description: The same pair cost with this venue's fees on both legs, in dollars. This is what you would actually pay.
